summary: Backend-only test of website AI endpoints and public chat regression after switch to OPENAI_OWN_MODEL=gpt-4o (own-key route) with Emergent LlmChat (gpt-5.2) as fallback in preview. All 3 tests PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview cannot exercise the own-OpenAI-key branch (_OpenAIChat with gpt-4o); only Emergent LlmChat (gpt-5.2) path is verified end-to-end. Owner path relies on unit-level check by main agent.
AI endpoints return 502 on failure - good. Consider adding retry/backoff around LLM calls to reduce transient 502s.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_website_ai.py covers /api/website/ai-generate, /api/website/ai-suggest-design, and /api/public/card/{slug}/chat regression. LLM calls typically finish within 15s in preview (Emergent). Use timeout>=90s. Own-key gpt-4o branch is not testable in preview (no OPENAI_API_KEY).
rca of the issue: Original bug: own-OpenAI-key path used alias 'gpt-5.2' which requires org verification unavailable to most users. Fix (verified): OPENAI_OWN_MODEL env with default 'gpt-4o' used by _OpenAIChat class; Emergent LlmChat route (preview) continues to use gpt-5.2 and works. Preview endpoints /api/website/ai-generate and /api/website/ai-suggest-design return HTTP 200 with all required keys and valid values.
